final_draft.answer: Yes. Multi-factor authentication is required for all employee accounts through our identity provider. SMS is not an accepted factor.

Access Control Policy section 4.2 supports it: all workforce members must use a second factor, and SMS is not accepted. Neither source names the identity provider or says which systems it covers. I didn't check any live settings, so nothing here confirms how MFA is set up today. The question doesn't name a GitHub organisation or AWS account, and none of the live checks looks at the identity provider. If you need proof that MFA is actually switched on, run the GitHub organisation two-factor check or the AWS root MFA check. These cover only GitHub and the AWS root user, not the identity provider.
